lineage.message: single receipt verification cannot prove receipt-tree lineage

findings.message: signature verifier could not resolve the issuer key

reading: The content address and the digest of the published receipt bytes recompute exactly, so the delivered receipt_ref is recomputable from the public file alone. The Ed25519 signature check reports 'signature_key_missing' here because the issuer key (kid local-7f140da0...) lives in the runx home that sealed the run; on that issuing home the same command returned valid:true. The receipt is additionally attested by a second, independently sealed run (5f0b62964930ee337af8de0ad1b13eb80dd168de15c6037da07ab73b0699ee4b) whose bytes are published at https://asporeteam.github.io/gin-sourcey-docs/receipt-agent3.json.
